signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: Sign in to see your saved journey.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Save your journey and pick it up on any device.
signup.terms: By creating an account, you agree to our Terms of Use and confirm you have read our Privacy Policy.
signup.checkInbox: Check your inbox and click the link we sent to confirm your account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.

newPassword.meta: Choose a new password | ÉireHome Flow
newPassword.title: Choose a new password
newPassword.intro: Enter a new password for your account.

google.terms: By continuing with Google, you agree to our Terms of Use and confirm you have read our Privacy Policy.
google.off: Google sign-in is not switched on yet. Please use your email for now.
google.failed: Google could not be opened. Please try again.

password.special: One special character, such as ! # $ or ?

privacyNote: Your account stores your name, your email and the steps you have completed, on servers in Ireland. With Google, it also keeps the profile picture link Google sends, which we do not use. Calculator figures stay in your browser. Read our Privacy Policy.

note.needLink: To choose a new password, open the link in your email again, or sign in first.
